title: Florida House, District 82
what_it_does: Represents District 82 (Hendry and Part of Collier) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Liesa Priddy
candidates.occupation: Rancher (JB Ranch, Immokalee); former banker; former Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission member
candidates.background: Liesa Priddy is a third-generation Immokalee rancher who, with her husband Russell, operates JB Ranch in Collier County. She holds a finance degree and an environmental studies degree, worked in banking and law-firm administration before returning to the ranch, and served on the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission from 2012 to 2017 by appointment of Gov. Rick Scott. She is a regional representative for the Florida Cattlemen's Association.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

immigration.summary: In her Q&A she says people here illegally should be deported and describes illegal immigration as a drain on the economy and resources.
immigration.quote: Those who are here illegally should be deported

sources.title: Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

property_tax.summary: She says she agrees with lowering taxes and making homeownership affordable but worries the homestead-elimination approach will simply shift taxes and hurt rural counties like Hendry; she says she would have supported a less drastic amendment.
property_tax.quote: I agree that we should lower taxes and make home ownership more affordable

sources.title: Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

taxes.summary: Her site lists reducing taxes on working Floridians as a campaign goal and says free enterprise, not excessive government, lets families and businesses prosper.
taxes.quote: Reduce Taxes on Hard Working Floridians

sources.title: Liesa Priddy for Florida House - campaign site home page
Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

guns.summary: Protecting Second Amendment rights is listed as her first campaign priority.

Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

insurance.summary: She supports continued state efforts to reduce insurance costs, home hardening and strong building codes, while noting insurers need adequate premiums to stay in business.

sources.title: Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

growth.summary: She supports planned growth, limiting zoning changes to control growth, and leaving growth management to county commissioners under home rule.

sources.title: Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

environment.summary: She supports continued Everglades restoration, improving Lake Okeechobee and converting septic tanks to sewer where feasible; her ranch has received conservation-stewardship awards.

Liesa Priddy for Florida House - campaign site home page

education_choice.summary: She says she supports school choice and that parents should have the final say in their child's education.
education_choice.quote: Parents should continue to have the final input as to their child's education

sources.title: Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

housing.summary: She supports increasing housing supply, expanding workforce housing and helping first-time homebuyers, along with reducing insurance costs that raise housing prices.

sources.title: Q & A with Liesa Priddy - campaign site

trump.summary: She describes herself as an America First conservative.

candidates.name: Arthur Boyer
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Arthur Boyer holds a doctorate in education and has worked for more than 20 years in the district as a classroom teacher, in community service, nonprofit advocacy and organizational coaching. He lives in Immokalee and is the father of an adult son.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

immigration.summary: His issues page supports what he calls a fair and humane immigration approach that upholds the rule of law while rejecting dehumanization and protecting families, and his site says he stands with TPS holders.
immigration.quote: a fair and humane immigration approach that upholds the rule of law while rejecting dehumanization and protecting families

sources.title: On the Issues - Arthur Boyer campaign site
Arthur Boyer campaign site home page
